sources.owner_or_issuer: USSR Ministry of Trade / collection developed by NIIOT with Ministry food-service administration and practitioners
observations: Order N 310 approved the collection and described it as the main technological normative document alongside standards/instructions.
The introduction says recipes were recalculated/refined on the basis of production trials/workups and that net/gross quantities and outputs are normative.
This is positive collection-level standardization evidence, not proof that every listed alternative branch was separately kitchen-tested.

used_for: independent historical corroboration of natural fried eggs margarine-or-butter structure
sources.limit: Corroboration of a source alternative does not establish FamilyFoodOS kitchen-tested substitution.

rights_decision.reason: The collection is government-approved but also names a developer collective; Candidate-A keeps factual quantities/rules as research evidence and does not republish source expressive text, layout, images or claim public-domain status.
